EntitySpec.title: EntitySpec type
EntitySpec.lead: A kind of entity a pack makes up. `base` is the last argument of every hook: call it and you extended, don't and you replaced.

members.name: on_spawn
members.description: Told when one of this kind is spawned; nothing waits on it and its answer is not read.

members.name: on_load
members.description: Told when one that already existed comes back: a saved chunk loaded it or a reload rebound it.

members.name: on_steer
members.description: Runs before the physics each tick to decide where it goes; call `base(e)` to extend, leave it out to replace.

members.name: on_tick
members.description: Runs after the physics each tick to react to where it ended up; call `base(e)` to extend.

members.name: on_think
members.description: define only. The brain: one call for all due bodies of the kind, with their numbers in columns. The engine never waits for it; the answer lands on the next tick it is there, and is never dropped.

members.name: on_damage
members.signature: entitySpec.on_damage((e: EntityHandle, amount: number, by: Player ?) -> ("take" | "ignore")?) → ?
members.description: Asked when a player hits it: answer "take" or "ignore". Nil or a missed deadline is "take". `by` is the player who hit.

members.name: on_remove
members.description: Told when it goes; `why` is "removed", "settled", "killed" or "unloaded". Not called when the pack goes away.

members.name: name
members.description: Your own word for the kind, lower case, digits and underscores; the pack's namespace is added for you ("rocket" is "rave:rocket").

members.name: looks
members.description: A shape the client draws, or a model from models.new.

members.name: physics
members.description: Which order of operations moves it: "living", "falling", "item", "none", or "vehicle" to drive by seat 1's keys.

members.name: size
members.description: One number, or { width, height }. An entity is as deep as it is wide.

members.name: persist
members.description: "save" brings it back with its chunk, `data` and all; "despawn", the default, is gone when the chunk goes.

members.name: seats
members.description: A model's: where riders sit (model units, seat 1 drives), its size, and what a client older than 1.21.4 sees.

members.name: scale
members.description: A model's size; 1 by default.

members.name: fallback
members.description: What a client older than 1.21.4 sees in place of the model, such as "minecart".

members.name: speed
members.description: How fast it goes, in blocks a second. A vehicle's top speed; a living body's walk at forward = 1, the game's own mob walk by default.

members.name: max_health
members.description: physics = "living" only: the most health it has, and what it starts with. 1 to 1024; 20 by default.

members.name: drops
members.description: physics = "living" only: what it leaves when it dies. Each row is { item = "stick", count = 2 }, count = { least, most } for a random count, chance = 0.05 for a row that comes from one death in twenty, or a pack item. false or nil: nothing.

members.name: sounds
members.signature: entitySpec.sounds: ({ hurt: string ?, death: string ?, ambient: string ? } | false)?
members.description: physics = "living" only: sound names for its hurt, its death and its idle sound, vanilla or "<pack>.<file>". false or nil: silent.

members.name: can_fly
members.description: physics = "living" only: it may fly when its pack sets e.flying = true, and it takes no fall damage.

members.name: turn
members.description: physics = "vehicle" only: degrees a second it turns at speed; 90 by default.

members.name: accel
members.description: physics = "vehicle" only: seconds from standing to top speed; 1 by default.

members.name: step
members.description: physics = "vehicle" only: blocks it climbs without a jump; 1 by default.

members.name: think_every
members.description: define only. Seconds between two thinks of one body; one tick (0.05) by default, at most 60. The engine spreads the bodies over the ticks.

Face.title: Face type
Face.lead: One of a block's six faces: up, down, north, south, west or east, as `hit.face` and `world.raycast` report it.

Faces.title: Faces type
Faces.lead: A block's faces: one picture, or `all`, `side`, `top`, `bottom`, `front`, `back`, or a face by name.

members.name: all
members.signature: faces.all: TextureRef ?, side: TextureRef ?, top: TextureRef ?, bottom: TextureRef ?
members.description: `all` is one picture for all six faces, `side` for the four sides (`all` if left out), `top` and `bottom` the ends.

members.name: front
members.description: `front` is the side a facing block faces and `back` the other; a face left out is `side`.

members.name: down
members.signature: faces.down: TextureRef ?, up: TextureRef ?, north: TextureRef ?, south: TextureRef ?, west: TextureRef ?, east: TextureRef ?
members.description: One face by its name; a face left out is `side`.

Facing.title: Facing type
Facing.lead: One of the four sides: north, south, west or east; a facing block's front, or the side a screen faces.

Feature.title: Feature type
Feature.lead: What a client is able to show. Ask this instead of comparing versions: a script never sees a version number.

Field.title: Field type
Field.lead: A number at every block, as a recipe the engine works out. Sums (`+ - * / ^` and unary minus) and the methods make new fields; a plain number is a field too. A field above 0.5 is "true" where a rule asks a question.

members.name: gt
members.description: 1 where this is the larger, else 0.

members.name: lt
members.description: 1 where this is the smaller, else 0.

members.name: smooth
members.description: 0 at `from`, 1 at `to`, smooth between. `from` may be the larger.

members.name: curve
members.description: Straight lines through `{ { input, output }, ... }`, inputs rising.

members.name: at
members.signature: field:at(dx: number, dy: number, dz: number) → Field
members.description: This field read `dx, dy, dz` blocks away: `fields.water:at(1, 0, 0)` is the water east of here.

FixedCamera.title: FixedCamera type
FixedCamera.lead: Camera modes expose only the fields they use. Values shared across players update all their views. A removed target reads nil and ends the active view.

FluidRule.title: FluidRule type
FluidRule.lead: The carved air under `below` becomes `block` (a lake, lava): the first rule that holds at each block. Never the open sky over the land.
FluidRule.typedef: { block: string, below: number, biome: string?, when: (Field | number)? }

Fx.title: fx global · type Fx
Fx.lead: Particles for a room: Minecraft's particle packet; the `fx` global, or `room.fx`.

members.name: particle
members.signature: fx.particle(name: string, pos: Vec3 | { Vec3 }, opts: { count: number ?, spread: (number | Vec3)?, velocity: Vec3 ?, speed: number ?, color: Ink ?, size: number ?, }?)
members.description: Shows particle `name` ("dust", "end_rod", "explosion", "firework", "flame", "note", "totem_of_undying") at `pos`, or at every point of a list. Each point reaches players in the room within 64 blocks of its origin in 3D, including the boundary, before spread or velocity. `count` (1) at each point in a box `spread` (0) out; or with `velocity`, one particle moving along it (`speed` 1 then, else 0). `color` and `size` are for dust only.

Game.title: game global · type Game
Game.lead: The game version a room runs, its entity kinds, blocks and items, and the pack's own blocks, items and recipes: the `game` global, or `room.game`.

members.name: block
members.description: Returns one block in this version's numbers, or nil for a name this game has no word for.

members.name: item
members.description: Returns an item this game has, or nil for a name it does not; never an error.

members.name: texture
members.signature: game.texture((width: number, height: number) -> Texture) → & ((file: string) -> Texture)
members.description: Returns a new texture of width by height pixels, see-through until drawn on, for a pack's block or item. A texture to draw on (512 at most a side), or a PNG file in the pack (4096 at most a side).

members.name: version
members.description: This game's version, such as "a0.1.0".

members.name: world_height
members.description: How tall the world is in blocks: 128, or 256 for a 1.8.9 world.

members.name: sea_level
members.description: The y of this world's sea level.

members.name: entities
members.description: The kinds of entity: `define` a pack's own, `amend` the game's own, and read a kind of the game: a mob kind by either spelling (`game.entities.cow`, `game.entities.Cow`), a kind that is not a mob by its name (`game.entities.arrow`); nil where the game has none. It iterates every kind, including pack definitions: `for name, kind in game.entities do`.

members.name: blocks
members.description: The one table that *adds* to a version rather than reading it.

members.name: biomes
members.description: Biomes of the pack's own: a vanilla biome with other colours and weather.

members.name: recipes
members.description: What a crafting grid and a furnace make of a pack's items; recipes are added while the pack loads.

members.name: items
members.description: Defines items of the pack's own, with a texture for clients from 1.21.4.

members.name: terrain
members.description: What this world's overworld is made of: `snow` and `steps`, as citadel.yml writes them; read-only, nil when there is no list.

Generated.title: Generated type
Generated.lead: A declared world, for the script to ask what the engine answers.

members.name: sample
members.signature: generated:sample(field: Field | number, pos: Vec3) → number ?
members.description: Returns a field's value at a position; `nil` for a field made after `world.generate`, or for rules with no `height`.

members.name: biome_at
members.description: Returns the biome name a column gets.

GeneratorRules.title: GeneratorRules type
GeneratorRules.lead: What `world.generate` takes. Without `height` and `density`, the rules add to the land the game's own terrain made.

members.name: height
members.description: The y of the surface.

members.name: density
members.description: Solid where this is above 0, for caves, overhangs and land in the air.

members.name: sea
members.description: Water fills the open air up to this y.

members.name: floor
members.description: The block at y 0; "bedrock" for a land of its own.

members.name: biomes
members.description: `{ "desert", when = field }`: the first that holds names the column's biome; one with no `when` is for the rest.

members.name: rock
members.description: The body of the land, under the ground rules.

members.name: fluids
members.description: What fills the caves: needs `density` or `carvers`.

members.name: carvers
members.description: The game version's own carvers, with the world seed, after the land and before the cave rules: "caves" (every version), "ravines" (b1.8 and later). Needs `height` or `density`.

members.name: structures
members.description: The game version's own structures, with spawners and loot: "mineshaft", "dungeon" (1.7 to 1.12). Needs `height` or `density`.

GroundItem.title: GroundItem type
GroundItem.lead: One stack lying on the ground.
GroundItem.typedef: { id: number, item: string, count: number, at: Vec3 }

GroundRule.title: GroundRule type
GroundRule.lead: A layer of ground: `block` for the top `depth` blocks (1) of a surface. The first rule that holds wins.
GroundRule.typedef: { block: BlockPick, biome: string?, when: (Field | number)?, depth: number? }

HeadSkin.title: HeadSkin type
HeadSkin.lead: Whose face a player head shows: a Minecraft account's name, or the `textures` profile property of a skin no account wears.

Hit.title: Hit type
Hit.lead: What `players.on_click` hands its callback: the button, the slot, and the player, entity, block and face the click met.

members.name: button
members.description: "left" is an attack or swing, "right" is an interact or use.

members.name: slot
members.description: The hotbar slot in hand, 1..9.

members.name: player
members.description: Another player, when that is what was clicked.

members.name: entity
members.description: The thing clicked, as the handle the script holds for it.

members.name: entity_id
members.description: Its raw entity id, which is all there is for something the engine made itself, such as one of a screen's own frames.

members.name: block
members.description: The block, when the click hit one.

members.name: face
members.description: The face of the block that was clicked.

Hitbox.title: Hitbox type
Hitbox.lead: An invisible box a player can click, and a wall when solid, from `world.hitbox` (1.19.4 and later).

members.name: destroy
members.description: Removes the hitbox, and its wall when solid.

members.name: id
members.description: Its entity id, what `players.on_click` reports in `hit.entity_id`.

members.name: at
members.description: Its bottom centre; write it to move the hitbox, and its wall when solid.

HttpResponse.title: HttpResponse type
HttpResponse.lead: What `http.get` returns. A failed request is not an error: read `ok`.

members.name: json
members.description: The body as a table; an error when it is not JSON.

members.name: image
members.signature: httpResponse:image() → {width: number, height: number, pixels: buffer}
members.description: A PNG body: `pixels` is 4 bytes (RGBA) a pixel, row by row from the top.

members.name: ok
members.description: True for a 2xx status.

members.name: status
members.description: The HTTP status; 0 when no answer came.

members.name: error
members.description: Why no answer came, or nil.

members.name: body
members.description: The answer as bytes.

members.name: headers
members.description: The answer's headers, names in lower case.

Hud.title: Hud type
Hud.lead: A layout on one player's screen, from `player.ui.show`. `hud.<id>` is the item with that id.

members.name: set
members.description: A value per id: a number is a fill, a string a label's words, true or false whether it shows. An unknown id is an error that lists the ids.

members.name: destroy
members.description: Takes it off the player's screen.

members.name: hover
members.description: With `cursor = true`: the id under the pointer, and what fires when it changes and on a click.

members.name: cursor
members.description: Where the pointer is, in the layout's pixels from its top left.

HudPart.title: HudPart type
HudPart.lead: One item of a shown layout, `hud.hp`: its live values. They tween.

members.name: fill
members.description: How much of a box or picture shows, from its left edge: 0 to 1.

members.name: text
members.description: A label's words.

members.name: visible
members.description: Whether it shows; nil shows it again.

members.name: color
members.description: A box's colour, a picture's tint, a label's ink; reads back as "#rrggbb".

Ink.title: Ink type
Ink.lead: Anywhere a colour is asked for, every spelling works: a `color` value, a name, or hex ("#ff8800"). A name nobody has is an error that says the nearest. A client from 1.16 gets the exact tone in text and an older one the nearest name it has.

InventorySlot.title: InventorySlot type
InventorySlot.lead: A stack as a script reads it. `id` is there for a pack item, `damage` for a worn tool.
InventorySlot.typedef: { item: string, count: number, id: string?, damage: number? }

Item.title: Item type
Item.lead: An item the game version has, from `game.item(name)`: its name and stack size.

ItemMatch.title: ItemMatch type
ItemMatch.lead: An item to find — `take`, `count`, a recipe's ingredient. A name is the plain item and never a pack item made of it; a table matches the fields it names.

ItemMeta.title: ItemMeta type
ItemMeta.lead: The extras an item table may carry: count, name, lore, colours, glint, a canvas map, a pack item id, wear, a 1.21.4+ model and a head's skin.

members.name: count
members.description: How many in the stack; 1 by default.

members.name: name
members.description: Never italic unless it says so.

members.name: lore
members.description: One line or a list of lines, grey unless they say otherwise.

members.name: color
members.description: A potion's liquid colour; 1.11 and later.

members.name: dye
members.description: Leather armour's colour.

members.name: glint
members.description: The enchanted shine, with no enchantment.

members.name: canvas
members.description: A filled map of that canvas: what the item *is*, so `item` may be left out. Everywhere an item is taken — a hand, a hotbar slot, a display.

members.name: id
members.description: A pack's own item: a brick with `id = "copper_ingot"` is a copper ingot, kept under the pack's name and known by it everywhere it goes.

members.name: damage
members.description: The wear a tool has taken; 0 is new.

members.name: model
members.description: The item model a 1.21.4+ client draws: `assets/<pack>/items/<model>.json`.

members.name: skin
members.description: The face a "player_head" item shows: a player's name, or the raw `textures` property. On any other item it is an error.

ItemSpec.title: ItemSpec type
ItemSpec.lead: An item is a name, or a table with the meta it carries.

ItemTable.title: ItemTable type
ItemTable.lead: An item table names an item, or a canvas whose map it is.

members.name: define
members.signature: items.define(spec: { name: string, texture: TextureRef ?, label: Text ?, lore: ({ Text } | Text)?, looks: string ?, stack: number ?, glint: boolean ?, }) → ItemTable
members.description: Load-time only. Hands back the item table: give it, match it, craft it.

Layout.title: Layout type
Layout.lead: A layout the resource pack holds: what `ui.define` hands back.

LayoutAlign.title: LayoutAlign type
LayoutAlign.lead: How a row, a column or a stack lines its children up, and a label its words.

LayoutNode.title: LayoutNode type
LayoutNode.lead: A piece of a layout's tree: what `ui.box`, `ui.image`, `ui.label`, `ui.row`, `ui.column` and `ui.stack` hand back. See "Layouts".

LetterStyle.title: LetterStyle type
LetterStyle.lead: What an effect hands back for one letter; `text` shows something else in its place ("" hides it).
LetterStyle.typedef: { color: Ink?, bold: boolean?, italic: boolean?, underline: boolean?, strike: boolean?, text: string? }

LightSource.title: LightSource type
LightSource.lead: One spot of light no block makes, for `world.light`: a position and a level from 1 to 15.

Looks.title: Looks type
Looks.lead: What a client is told a pack's entity is: a shape it already draws. The two table forms carry a payload — the block a falling block shows, the stack an item shows.
Looks.typedef: string | { entity: string, block: string } | { entity: string, item: string }

Material.title: Material type
Material.lead: A block's material as five yes-or-no questions, from `block.material`: solid, covers, firm, liquid and burns.

members.name: solid
members.description: Whether the jar's Material counts as solid.

members.name: covers
members.description: Grass under it dies.

members.name: firm
members.description: Snow and ice need it beneath them.

members.name: liquid
members.description: Whether the jar's Material is a liquid.

members.name: burns
members.description: Whether the jar's Material burns.

members.name: destroy
members.description: Takes it down and forgets its callbacks. A Bedrock form cannot be taken back: it stays until the player answers, and the answer then lands nowhere.

members.name: update
members.description: New pictures in place, the menu left open: a bar that fills, a count that changes. `on_pick` still answers by position. `false` once the player has put it away; a Bedrock form keeps what it showed.

Model.title: Model type
Model.lead: A model the pack made, for `world.display{ kind = "model" }`.

members.name: name
members.description: The name the model was given in `models.new`.

ModelBuild.title: ModelBuild type
ModelBuild.lead: What `models.new` hands its build function: makes the model's materials, textures, parts and animations.

members.name: material
members.signature: modelBuild:material(name: string, color: Ink, opts: { grain: number ?, alpha: number ? }?) → ModelMaterial
members.description: Makes a named colour a display may repaint; `grain` (0 to 1) darkens pixels into four tones, `alpha` below 1 is glass.

members.name: texture
members.signature: modelBuild:texture(width: number, height: number, opts: { tint: ModelMaterial ?, scroll: ("up" | "down" | "left" | "right")?, speed: number ? }?) → ModelTexture
members.description: Makes a pixel picture for one face; with `tint`, drawn in greys and coloured by that material. With `scroll`, it moves by itself on a block drawn from the model, `speed` texels a tick (1, 2, 3, or 0.5, 0.25).

members.name: part
members.signature: modelBuild:part(name: string, opts: { pivot: Vec3 ? }?) → ModelPart
members.description: Makes a named child part of the root that turns around its `pivot`, the model's origin unless given.

members.name: animation
members.description: `{ length = seconds, loop = false, <part name> = { rotation = { [t] = is both named fields and part names, so this one is open.

ModelDisplay.title: ModelDisplay type
ModelDisplay.lead: A model visual in a room. Shares at, rotation, scale, alive and move with other visuals; adds named animations and model materials.

members.name: move
members.description: Place and turn it in one step, every part and seat together.

members.name: play
members.description: Starts an animation; replaying the current one changes speed without restarting.

members.name: stop
members.description: Where it is; the parts stay as they are.

members.name: destroy
members.description: Removes the model from the room.

members.name: id
members.description: What `player:ride(model)` is handed; the seat is picked from `seats`.

members.name: paint
members.description: Whether it is still present. Read-only. Where it stands; live, and each write is a move of its own. Partial writes preserve other angles; nil after removal. Reads vec3; write a number or equal-axis vec3 for uniform size. Nil when gone. Material name to colour; write-only.

ModelMaterial.title: ModelMaterial type
ModelMaterial.lead: A flat colour in a model. A display repaints it by this name.

members.name: name
members.description: The name it was made with, which a display repaints it by.

ModelPart.title: ModelPart type
ModelPart.lead: A named group of boxes that turns around its pivot. Units are 16 to the block, the origin is the model's bottom centre, and a box reaches -24..24.

members.name: part
members.signature: modelPart:part(name: string, opts: { pivot: Vec3 ? }?) → ModelPart
members.description: Makes a child part of this one; it turns around `pivot`, the model's origin unless you give one.

members.name: box
members.signature: modelPart:box(from: Vec3, to: Vec3, skin: ModelSkin, opts: { rotation: Vec3 ?, pivot: Vec3 ?, faces: { [Face]: ModelSkin }?, }?)
members.description: Corners in any order; a box turns on one axis, in steps of 22.5 up to 45, and `pivot` is the box's own centre unless you give one.

members.name: hitbox
members.description: A box a player can hit on a living body that wears the model (clients from 1.19.4). Not drawn; corners in any order, in model units. Square from above (its longer side), so split a long part. Animations do not move it. A model with none is hit on one box of the body's `size`.

members.name: mirror
members.description: A mirrored copy of every box and hitbox this part has, and a mirrored twin named `<name>_mirrored` of every child. Only "x" in this version.

ModelSkin.title: ModelSkin type
ModelSkin.lead: What a box wears: one for all six faces, or one per face.

ModelTexture.title: ModelTexture type
ModelTexture.lead: Pixel art for one face of a box: plain RGBA, and never repainted.

members.name: fill
members.description: Paints every pixel one colour.

members.name: pixel
members.signature: modelTexture:pixel(x: number, y: number, color: Ink)
members.description: Paints the pixel at x, y; `colors.transparent` makes it see-through.

members.name: rect
members.signature: modelTexture:rect(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, color: Ink)
members.description: Paints a rectangle `w` by `h` pixels from x, y.

members.name: draw
members.signature: modelTexture:draw(picture: Texture, x: number ?, y: number ?)
members.description: A game.texture over this one, its top left at x, y; see-through pixels skipped, what falls outside cut.

MountTarget.title: MountTarget type
MountTarget.lead: Handles accepted by mounting and cameras; a Model is an asset, not a target.
MountTarget.typedef: EntityHandle | Npc | Display | ModelDisplay | Hitbox | Puppet

NetworkInstance.title: NetworkInstance type
NetworkInstance.lead: An instance of a member: a server the network started for itself.

members.name: id
members.description: The instance's name. `player:connect` takes it.

members.name: state
members.description: "starting", then "online", then "stopping".

members.name: open
members.description: The number of players it takes now, as it said with `network.status`.

members.name: status
members.description: The instance's own word.

members.name: players
members.description: The number of players on it.

members.name: meta
members.description: The instance's own value.

members.name: state
members.description: "starting" or "online".

Noise.title: Noise type
Noise.lead: Smooth random numbers from `noise.new`: the same seed gives the same numbers every time.

members.name: get
members.signature: noise:get(x: number, y_or_z: number, z: number ?) → number
members.description: Returns about -1..1 at a point: `get(x, z)` for a height map, `get(x, y, z)` for caves and overhangs.

members.name: grid
members.signature: noise:grid(x: number, z: number, width: number, depth: number) → { number }
members.description: Returns `width * depth` heights in one call, row by row: the number for `(x + dx, z + dz)` is at `[dz * width + dx + 1]`.

Npc.title: Npc type
Npc.lead: A player-shaped entity every client from 1.8 sees, from `world.npc`; it can walk, talk, hold items, wear armour and ride.

members.name: look_at
members.description: Where it stands; live, so setting it moves the NPC. A riding NPC reads the seat's position. Partial writes preserve other angles; nil after removal. Bodies have no roll. Turns head and body toward a point.

members.name: swing
members.description: Plays the arm swing animation.

members.name: hold
members.description: Puts an item in the main hand; nil or false empties it. An error on an unknown item.

members.name: say
members.description: Sends a chat line "<name> ..." to the room, or just the words for an NPC with no name.

members.name: walk
members.signature: npc:walk(opts: { path: { Vec3 }, speed: number ?, loop: boolean ? }?)
members.description: Walks the points by itself, facing where it goes; nil stops it.

members.name: wear
members.description: Puts armour on it, head first; each piece is an item.

members.name: ride
members.signature: npc:ride(thing: MountTarget, opts: { seat: number ? }?) → boolean
members.description: Sits in a seat as `player:ride` does, and never drives; `false` when somebody sits there.

members.name: dismount
members.description: Gets off where it sits; set `at` after it to put it somewhere else.

members.name: move
members.description: Removes the NPC. Sets position and optional rotation together.

members.name: id
members.description: The entity id, what `players.on_click` reports in `hit.entity_id`.

members.name: name
members.description: Whether it is still present. Read-only. "" for one made with no name, which has no name tag.

members.name: walking
members.description: True while it walks a path, until the last point; never false with `loop`.

members.name: pose
members.description: How the body is held; live.

members.name: riding
members.description: Whether it sits in a seat; live.

NpcPose.title: NpcPose type
NpcPose.lead: How an NPC holds its body: standing, crouching, sleeping or swimming.

Orientation.title: Orientation type
Orientation.lead: Displays also accept a nose direction and roof direction; reads return angles.

Overlay.title: Overlay type
Overlay.lead: A canvas on one player's screen, from `player.ui.overlay`: 128 by 128, drawn like a canvas. Row 0 is the engine's and never shows; draw in rows 1 to 127. Colour `colors.transparent` shows the game through it.

members.name: destroy
members.description: Takes it off the player's screen.

members.name: open
members.description: True until `destroy` or the player leaves.

PartDefinition.title: PartDefinition type
PartDefinition.lead: A named part of a stored world (`world: <folder>`) and the generator that writes it. Declared, not run: `citadel generate <pack> --part <name>`, or `/part generate <name>` in build mode, runs it; a changed file runs it again while nobody has edited the part. See "parts" in docs/luau-api.md.

members.name: build
members.description: Exactly a world.build function.

members.name: name
members.description: Unique; a path, "downtown/tower-3", nests.

members.name: at
members.description: Where the build's block (0, 0, 0) lands.

members.name: detail
members.description: 1 (whole blocks, the default) or 2 (half blocks), as world.build.

Persist.title: Persist type
Persist.lead: Whether a kind survives a save. "save" puts it in the chunk record, `data` and all; "despawn" is gone when the chunk goes.

Physics.title: Physics type
Physics.lead: Which order of operations moves a body. Not a table of floats: the floats are the game version's, and this says which set of them applies.

Picture.title: Picture type
Picture.lead: The calls a screen, a canvas and a view all share.

members.name: clear
members.description: Its width in pixels: 128 for each map across. Its height in pixels: 128 for each map down. Paints every pixel one colour; black by default. On a view, the default clears it to see-through.

members.name: set
members.signature: picture:set(x: number, y: number, color: Ink)
members.description: Paints one pixel; (0, 0) is the top-left.

members.name: fill
members.signature: picture:fill(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, color: Ink)
members.description: Fills a w by h box of pixels with one colour, its top-left at (x, y).

members.name: rect
members.signature: picture:rect(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, color: Ink, radius: number ?)
members.description: Fills a box like `fill`, with smoothed rounded corners of `radius` pixels when given.

members.name: circle
members.signature: picture:circle(x: number, y: number, r: number, color: Ink)
members.description: Fills a circle of radius `r` pixels around (x, y).

members.name: text
members.signature: picture:text(x: number, y: number, text: string, color: Ink, size: number ?) → number
members.description: Draws text in DejaVu Sans Bold, `size` pixels tall (16 by default), smoothed; returns its width in pixels.

members.name: measure
members.description: The width in pixels that `text` would draw, without drawing it; for centring.

members.name: line
members.signature: picture:line(x0: number, y0: number, x1: number, y1: number, color: Ink, width: number ?)
members.description: Draws a smoothed line with round ends, `width` pixels wide (1 by default); positions may be fractions.

members.name: ring
members.signature: picture:ring(x: number, y: number, r: number, color: Ink, width: number ?)
members.description: Draws a circle's outline, `width` pixels wide (1 by default), smoothed.

members.name: polygon
members.signature: picture:polygon(points: { { number } | { x: number, y: number } }, color: Ink)
members.description: Fills a smoothed shape with any number of corners; a point is `{x, y}` or `{ x = .., y = .. }`.

members.name: gradient
members.signature: picture:gradient(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, from: Ink, to: Ink, across: string ?)
members.description: Fills a box that fades from `from` to `to`, top to bottom; `"across"` runs it left to right.

members.name: sprite
members.signature: picture:sprite(x: number, y: number, rows: { string }, inks: { [string]: Ink }, scale: number ?)
members.description: Draws pixel art: each string a row, each character a dot `scale` pixels square (1 by default); a character with no ink is skipped.

members.name: pixels
members.signature: picture:pixels(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, data: buffer | string)
members.description: Writes raw RGB bytes (a buffer or a string), three a pixel, row by row, into a w by h box.

members.name: draw
members.signature: picture:draw(source: Screen | Canvas | View, x: number ?, y: number ?)
members.description: Draws another screen, canvas or view with its top-left at (x, y), skipping its transparent pixels.

members.name: part
members.signature: picture:part(col: number, row: number) → { id: number }
members.description: One map of the picture, `{ id = .. }`, by column and row from (0, 0) top- left; for a hand or a single frame.

members.name: play
members.signature: picture:play(opts: { file: string, fps: number ?, loop: boolean ? }) → Video
members.description: Plays a raw RGB video file from the pack at `fps` 0.5 to 20, the engine drawing each frame; returns the Video.

PlantRule.title: PlantRule type
PlantRule.lead: A plant on a column. Each column takes at most one: a rule that holds is tried with its `chance` (1), in the order of the list.

members.name: blocks
members.description: The blocks from the foot up, in place of `block`: a two-block flower.

members.name: tip
members.description: With `height`, the block on top of a plant that grows.

members.name: height
members.description: How many blocks a plant that grows is tall: `block` repeats.

members.name: afloat
members.description: On the water over a column, not on its ground.

members.name: sink
members.description: Blocks to stand lower: 1 is in the ground, or in the top of the water.

members.name: clear
members.description: Blocks of water to keep clear over a plant that grows in it.

members.name: place
members.description: Where it goes: "top" (the default), or in the caves `density` or `carvers` dig: "floor", "ceiling" (it hangs down: `tip` is lowest) or "wall" (one block; `{wall}` in its name is the side the rock is on, `{facing}` the side away). One plant on each floor and each ceiling of a cave, and in each wall block. `when` and `chance` are read at the air block it starts in.

members.name: y
members.description: `{ low, high }`: the y it may start at.

Player.title: Player type
Player.lead: A player in the room: what `players.on_join` and every player event hand you.

members.name: ride
members.signature: player:ride(thing: MountTarget, opts: { seat: number ?, locked: boolean ? }?) → boolean
members.description: The player's name. The account's own id: the one name for a player a rename does not change. Where they stand now. Your own table, kept on the player for as long as they are connected. A player is one value while connected: `a == b` and `t[player]` work. The Room the player is in; nil while they move between rooms. Degrees: `yaw` sideways, `pitch` up or down; live, read only. True while the player sneaks; live. `attack` is the left button held on a block in reach (see player.reach); a client says nothing about a button held on air. True while the player sits on something; live. Seat 1 drives a vehicle; `locked` keeps a sneak from getting them off. `false` when somebody sits in that seat; keeps the current ride on failure. Works immediately after creating the target. Repeating the same ride keeps the seat; no delay or extra movement is needed.

members.name: dismount
members.description: Gets the player off what they ride; sneaking does the same, as off a horse.

members.name: message
members.description: What shows on this player's screen: the calls `ui` has, for them alone, plus their own menu and overlay. Sends a chat line to this player alone; `color` is for the words that did not pick one. Chat is not part of the screen, so it is not in `ui`.

members.name: sound
members.signature: player:sound(name: string, opts: { at: Vec3 ?, volume: number ?, pitch: number ?, category: string ?, }?)
members.description: Plays a sound by name to this player only, with an optional position, volume, pitch and category.

members.name: teleport
members.description: Yaw and pitch left out keep the way they face.

members.name: move_to
members.description: Moves the player to another room; the client swaps worlds in place.

members.name: travel
members.description: Sends the player to another world of the group, at `pos` or its spawn.

members.name: give
members.description: One item: "stone", or { item = "arrow", count = 16 }.

members.name: held
members.description: Returns the stack in hand ({ item, count }, plus `id` for a pack item and `damage` for a worn tool), or nil.

members.name: inventory
members.description: Returns one { item, count } row per filled slot.

members.name: take
members.description: Up to `count` (1 unless you say) of what matches, the hand first; answers how many it took.

members.name: set_held
members.description: The stack in hand, replaced; nil or false empties the hand.

members.name: hotbar
members.description: Replaces the nine hotbar slots; a missing index is empty.

members.name: wear
members.description: The four armour slots; a piece left out is bare.

members.name: kill
members.description: 0..20, or nil where the game version has no food bar. The food saturation, or nil where the game version has no food bar. True while the player is on the death screen. Kills the player; returns false on a version with no damage rules.

members.name: hide
members.description: This player stops seeing `other`, or sees them again.

members.name: show
members.description: This player sees `other` again after a `hide`.

members.name: can_see
members.description: True unless `other` is not visible or is hidden from this player.

members.name: effect
members.signature: player:effect(name: string, opts: { level: number ?, duration: number ?, particles: boolean ? }?)
members.description: A potion effect by its modern name; `duration` in seconds, math.huge for ever.

members.name: clear_effect
members.description: Takes a potion effect off the player, by its modern name.

members.name: push
members.description: A shove in blocks per tick, on top of what they are doing.

members.name: damage
members.description: A hit in half-hearts: the flash, the sound, the resistance window. `false` on a version with no damage rules.

members.name: look_at
members.description: Turns the player's head to a point, where they stand.

members.name: stop_sound
members.description: Where their view is from: the camera they look out of, or their eyes. One sound by name, or every sound; 1.13 and later.

members.name: kick
members.description: Disconnects the player, with that text on their screen.

members.name: connect
members.description: Asks Minefort to move the player to another server by name: an instance's `id`, the network's name (its default member) or "hub". Minefort decides and does not answer; a player still here was not moved.

members.name: count
members.description: Returns how many of an item the player carries, across every slot.

members.name: has
members.description: True if the player's groups give them this permission node; operators have every node.

members.name: groups
members.description: Returns the player's groups; `default` is not listed.

members.name: add_group
members.description: Puts the player in a group until they leave; errors on a group citadel.yml does not define.

members.name: remove_group
members.description: Takes the player out of a group.

members.name: supports
members.description: True if this player's client can show the feature.

members.name: look
members.description: Returns the unit vector the player faces.

members.name: set_slot
members.description: Selects hotbar slot 1..9.

members.name: gamemode
members.description: The hotbar slot in hand, 1..9; live. 0 survival, 1 creative, 2 adventure, 3 spectator; writable.

members.name: spawn_point
members.description: The player's own respawn point (the block of the position), or nil for the room's. Writable; a point a pack sets needs no bed. nil clears it, a bed's point too.

members.name: max_health
members.description: Their health now, 0 to `max_health`; nil where the game version has no damage rules. Writable: set outright, no flash; 0 is a death; a number above `max_health` stops there. The most health they can have: 20 unless a pack set it; nil where the game version has no damage rules. Writable, 1 to 1024; nil gives the game's own back. A lower maximum takes `health` down to it. It lasts for the session. Every Java client draws its hearts; Bedrock draws none.

members.name: speed
members.description: The body: what a pack sets on a player. See docs/luau-api.md, "Body and movement". Walk speed as a multiple of normal; 0 pins them.

members.name: can_fly
members.description: May fly in a mode that cannot.

members.name: visible
members.description: false: no other player is sent this body. The tab line stays. true or nil shows the body again.

members.name: scale
members.description: 1/16 to 16; 1.20.5 and later, older clients stay as they are.

members.name: reach
members.description: How far a block can be clicked or dug, 0 to 64 blocks (4.5 by default); 1.20.5 and later. Measured from the camera when there is one.

members.name: level
members.description: The experience bar: the number over it, and how full it is (0..1).

members.name: xp
members.description: How full the experience bar is, 0..1.

members.name: camera
members.description: What they look out of: a camera from camera.fixed/free/orbit/chase, or nil or false for their own eyes. No delay is needed after creating its target. Ends when the target is destroyed or the player leaves the room.

members.name: time
members.description: This player's sky alone, held at a time of day; nil or false gives them the room's again, as does moving rooms. Reads back in ticks.

PlayerUi.title: PlayerUi type
PlayerUi.lead: `player.ui`: the calls `ui` has, for one player alone, plus what only one player's screen holds.

members.name: menu
members.signature: playerUi.menu(opts: { title: Text ?, items: { ItemSpec }, on_pick: (player: Player, n: number) -> (), on_close: ((player: Player) -> ())?, }) → Menu
members.description: A titled grid of up to 54 items over the player's view; each pick is answered by `on_pick(player, n)`. Nothing goes in or out of it: the items are pictures, not stacks. A chest on Java, a form of buttons on Bedrock. `on_close` fires when the player puts it away without picking. A new menu replaces the open one.

members.name: overlay
members.signature: playerUi.overlay(opts: { corner: ("top_left" | "top_right" | "bottom_left" | "bottom_right")?, size: number ?, margin: number ? }?) → Overlay ?
members.description: Puts a canvas in a corner of this player's screen, `size` screen pixels square at GUI scale 1 (96 by default, 16 to 511), `margin` from the edges (4 by default); nil where `player:supports("overlay")` is false.

members.name: show
members.description: Puts a layout on this player's screen. A client older than 1.21.4 (`player:supports("layout")`) gets a handle that shows nothing.

members.name: dialog
members.description: A screen of boxes, words and pictures (see "Dialogs"): a `ui.kit.window{}`, or a function that returns one and is drawn again after every click. nil where `player:supports("dialog")` is false.

Players.title: players global · type Players
Players.lead: A room's players and their events: the `players` global, or `room.players`.

members.name: on_join
members.description: Calls `fn` when a player arrives: on the globals when a client connects, on a room's table each time a player moves into it.

members.name: on_leave
members.description: The same player value on_join had; it can no longer be sent to.

members.name: list
members.description: Returns every player in the room.

members.name: get
members.description: Returns the player with this name, or nil.

members.name: count
members.description: Returns how many players are in the room.

members.name: near
members.description: Who is within a radius of a point, and who is inside a box of blocks.

members.name: within
members.description: Returns every player inside a box of blocks, corners included.

members.name: on_click
members.description: Calls `fn` on a left or right click; `hit` holds the button and the entity, player, block and face it met.

members.name: on_sneak
members.description: Calls `fn` once per sneak press and release; `down` is true on the press.

members.name: on_slot
members.description: Calls `fn` when a player picks a hotbar slot, 1..9.

members.name: on_chat
members.signature: players.on_chat(fn: (player: Player, text: string) -> boolean ?) → Connection
members.description: Return false and the line is not said.

members.name: on_pickup
members.signature: players.on_pickup(fn: (player: Player ?, item: string, count: number) -> ()) → Connection
members.description: A stack taken off the ground, and one that landed on it. `player` is nil where the world dropped it, or where they have already left.

members.name: on_drop
members.signature: players.on_drop(fn: (player: Player ?, item: string, count: number) -> ()) → Connection
members.description: Calls `fn` when a stack lands on the ground; `player` is nil where the world dropped it or they have left.

members.name: on_death
members.signature: players.on_death(fn: (player: Player ?, cause: string, message: string, by: Player ?) -> ()) → Connection
members.description: Calls `fn` when a player dies, with the cause (fall, drown, void, lava, ...) and the line broadcast; `player` is nil once they have left.

members.name: on_respawn
members.description: Calls `fn` when a player respawns; `player` is nil once they have left.

members.name: on_break
members.signature: players.on_break(fn: (player: Player ?, pos: Vec3, block: string) -> boolean ?) → Connection
members.description: Cancellable. Return `false` to stop it; return nothing to let it through. These are asked *before* the world changes and the engine waits milliseconds for the answer, so they must be quick and must never `task.wait`.  Timeout, error, overflow and disabled handlers deny the action. Across packs any `false` wins. See docs/luau-api.md, "saying no".

members.name: on_place
members.signature: players.on_place(fn: (player: Player ?, pos: Vec3, block: string) -> boolean ?) → Connection
members.description: Asks `fn` before a player puts a block down; return false to cancel it. A missed deadline denies the place.

members.name: on_damage
members.signature: players.on_damage(fn: (player: Player ?, hit: DamageHit) -> boolean ?) → Connection
members.description: Asks `fn` before damage lands on a player; return false to refuse it. A missed deadline denies it. A pack's own `player:damage` is not asked about.

Puppet.title: Puppet type
Puppet.lead: A mob's body with no mind of its own that the script moves, from `world.puppet`; its name tag always shows.

members.name: destroy
members.description: Removes the puppet.

members.name: id
members.description: The raw entity id.

members.name: name
members.description: The text of its name tag, which is always shown.

RayHit.title: RayHit type
RayHit.lead: The first block a ray met, and the face it came in through.

Recipes.title: Recipes type
Recipes.lead: `game.recipes`: what a crafting grid and a furnace make of a pack's items. Load-time only, like a block definition. The game's own recipes are asked first, so a pack adds and never takes away.

members.name: shaped
members.signature: recipes.shaped(spec: { pattern: { string }, keys: { [string]: ItemMatch }, result: ItemSpec })
members.description: 1 to 3 rows of 1 to 3 letters; a space is an empty cell.

members.name: shapeless
members.description: Adds a crafting recipe whose ingredients may go anywhere in the grid.

members.name: smelt
members.description: Adds a furnace recipe; a furnace smelts a pack item only by one of these.

Room.title: Room type
Room.lead: An isolated world with its own players and tables, from `rooms.create` or `rooms.main`.

members.name: message
members.description: This room's `world` table: its blocks, entities and displays. This room's `players` table; its `on_join` fires each time a player moves in. This room's `sound` table. This room's `fx` table. This room's `ui` table. This room's `game` table: the game version it runs, its entity kinds and blocks. This room's `commands` table. Sends a chat line to everyone in this room.

members.name: destroy
members.description: Takes the room away; players still in it keep the world. Does nothing to `rooms.main`.

members.name: spawn_point
members.description: The room's number. Rooms also compare by identity with `==`. Where players arrive in this room; writable. A write is not stored and does not move the chunks that stay loaded.

Rules.title: Rules type
Rules.lead: Which parts of the player simulation this room runs. All on for a `mode: full` server, all off on a pack server until the pack says. `survival` is the whole game: digging and its drops, placing, the inventory and crafting, respawning — and it turns fall, damage, hunger and day_cycle on. `anticheat` is on everywhere until a pack turns it off, and so is `redstone`: off, no signal moves in the room.
Rules.typedef: { survival: boolean, fall: boolean, damage: boolean, hunger: boolean, anticheat: boolean, day_cycle: boolean, redstone: boolean }

Schematic.title: Schematic type
Schematic.lead: A box of blocks: a `.schem` file from the pack, read once by `world.schematic`, or one a script wrote with `world.build`. `min` is the build's own lowest corner, which is the corner `origin` puts down; a file has no coordinates of its own, so its `min` is zero.

members.name: rotate
members.description: The build's width, height and length in blocks. The build's own lowest corner, which `origin` puts down; zero for a file. A new build turned clockwise seen from above (90, 180 or 270), states and all.

members.name: mirror
members.description: A new build flipped: "x" swaps east and west, "z" north and south.

Screen.title: Screen type
Screen.lead: A wall or floor of map frames showing a picture, from `world.screen`; it draws like a canvas and can answer clicks by pixel.

members.name: on_click
members.signature: screen.on_click(((player: Player, x: number, y: number, button: "left" | "right") -> ()) | false) → ?
members.description: Called with the pixel the player points at and the button, when a player clicks the screen. nil or false takes the hook off.

members.name: view
members.description: Returns this player's own layer over the screen; only they see it, and the shared picture shows where it is see-through.

members.name: destroy
members.description: Removes the screen.

ScreenFacing.title: ScreenFacing type
ScreenFacing.lead: The side a frame display hangs on: a wall side, or "up" to lie flat on a floor or table (1.13 and later).

ShopPurchase.title: ShopPurchase type
ShopPurchase.lead: A purchase the player paid for, in Gems, that the pack has not handed over.

members.name: player
members.description: The player's uuid.

members.name: product
members.description: The product's key.

Slow.title: Slow type
Slow.lead: One overrun, as `citadel.on_slow` is handed it.

members.name: hook
members.description: The short name of the hook that ran out: "on_tick", "every", or the event's own.

members.name: of
members.description: The pack's budget per tick, in milliseconds: `budget_ms` in citadel.yml.

members.name: used
members.description: Milliseconds the pack spent in the tick that ran out.

members.name: skipped
members.description: Callbacks not run for want of budget, since the script started.

Socket.title: Socket type
Socket.lead: A WebSocket a pack opened with `http.socket`.

members.name: send
members.description: True while the connection is up. Terminal receive-queue overflow; nil otherwise. Queues text; false when closed or full. Messages over 1 MiB are errors.

members.name: cancel
members.description: Closes the socket for good.

members.name: json
members.description: The message as a table; an error when it is not JSON.

members.name: text
members.description: The message as text.

Sound.title: sound global · type Sound
Sound.lead: Plays and stops sounds for everyone in a room: the `sound` global, or `room.sound`.

members.name: play
members.signature: sound.play(name: string, opts: { at: Vec3 ?, volume: number ?, pitch: number ?, category: string ?, }?)
members.description: Plays a sound by name to everyone in the room; volume above 1 carries further, pitch 0.5..2.0.

members.name: stop
members.description: One sound by name, or every sound, for everyone in the room; 1.13+.

members.name: stream
members.signature: sound.stream(opts: { url: string ?, file: string ?, at: (SoundSpeaker | { SoundSpeaker })?, to: (Player | { Player })?, distance: number ?, loop: boolean ?, name: string ?, }) → SoundStream
members.description: A live stream (MP3, or an FLV's sound) or a pack's sound file (OGG, MP3, WAV), heard through the mod a screen's stream uses. With `at`, from speakers: each player hears every speaker within `distance`. Without, from no place, at one volume. `to`: only these players. `loop`: files only.

SoundSpeaker.title: SoundSpeaker type
SoundSpeaker.lead: Where a speaker is: a point, or a player or an entity it follows.

SoundStream.title: SoundStream type
SoundStream.lead: A sound `sound.stream` plays. Speakers are numbered from 1.

members.name: move
members.description: Speakers, for a sound made with `at`; on one with no place, an error.

members.name: listen
members.description: Who hears it, changed while it plays.

members.name: playing
members.description: False once stopped, or once a file that does not loop has played.

Suggester.title: Suggester type
Suggester.lead: Called as the player types; must answer at once (no task.wait). `args` holds the arguments typed before this one, by name.
Suggester.typedef: (player: Player, typed: string, args: { [string]: any }) -> { Suggestion }

Suggestion.title: Suggestion type
Suggestion.lead: One word offered as a player types a command argument: a string, or a text with a tooltip.

TerrainStep.title: TerrainStep type
TerrainStep.lead: One populate step of the overworld, as citadel.yml writes it, read from `game.terrain.steps`.

members.name: step
members.description: Which populate step: "dungeons", "clay", "ore", "trees", "patch", "reeds", "cactus", "springs" or "snow".

members.name: block
members.description: The block a clay, ore or patch step places.

members.name: fluid
members.description: The fluid a springs step places: "water" or "lava".

members.name: count
members.description: How many tries, veins, blobs, clumps or springs the step makes in a chunk.

members.name: size
members.description: How long each clay blob or ore vein is.

members.name: below
members.description: An ore step places its veins below this y.

members.name: bonus
members.description: Trees: one chunk in this many gets one more tree.

members.name: big
members.description: Trees: one chunk in this many grows big trees instead of small ones.

members.name: chance
members.description: Patch: made one time in this many, in place of `count` times.

members.name: bound
members.description: Springs: the y is picked below this bound before `nesting` pushes it deeper.

members.name: nesting
members.description: Springs: how many times the y is picked again below itself; lava's 2 keeps it deeper than water's 1.

Text.title: Text type
Text.lead: A string, a table of runs, or a function of the time (`time.now()`) handing back a text, worked out again every frame it is on screen.

TextRuns.title: TextRuns type
TextRuns.lead: Words wherever the API shows them: a string, or a table of runs. A table's entries are its runs in order (each a string or another table), and its named fields are the style of all of them; a run that names its own style keeps it. See "text" in docs/luau-api.md.

members.name: color
members.description: The colour of every run that does not pick its own: a colour value, a name or hex.

members.name: bold
members.description: Bold for every run that does not say otherwise.

members.name: italic
members.description: Italic for every run that does not say otherwise.

members.name: underline
members.description: Underlined for every run that does not say otherwise.

members.name: strike
members.description: Struck through for every run that does not say otherwise.

members.name: effect
members.description: Called for every letter, every frame the text is on screen: hands back how that letter looks, or nil to leave it.

Texture.title: Texture type
Texture.lead: A picture drawn in code: `game.texture(w, h)`. Where a texture is taken, a string is a PNG file in the pack instead.

members.name: fill
members.description: Paints every pixel one colour.

members.name: pixel
members.signature: texture:pixel(x: number, y: number, color: Ink)
members.description: Sets one pixel; (0, 0) is the top left.

members.name: rect
members.signature: texture:rect(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, color: Ink)
members.description: Fills a rectangle of pixels.

members.name: frame
members.signature: texture:frame(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, color: Ink)
members.description: Draws a box's outline, one pixel wide.

members.name: noise
members.signature: texture:noise(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, colors: { Ink }, seed: number ?)
members.description: Paints each pixel in the area one of the colours at random, as for stone, bark or grain.

members.name: sprite
members.signature: texture:sprite(x: number, y: number, rows: { string }, inks: { [string]: Ink }, scale: number ?)
members.description: Draws pixel art from rows of characters, each character painted with its ink, as on a screen.

members.name: draw
members.signature: texture:draw(other: Texture, x: number ?, y: number ?)
members.description: Draws another texture over this one; its see-through pixels are skipped.

members.name: copy
members.description: Returns a copy to draw on.

members.name: width
members.description: Width in pixels.

members.name: height
members.description: Height in pixels.

TextureRef.title: TextureRef type
TextureRef.lead: A block or item picture: a `Texture` drawn in code with `game.texture`, or the name of a PNG file in the pack.

ThingGrid.title: ThingGrid type
ThingGrid.lead: Things that share one grid of `cell` blocks (8): a cell holds at most one, at a place that is the cell's own, so a thing over a chunk border is whole.

ThingRule.title: ThingRule type
ThingRule.lead: A thing that stands on a grid cell: one of `shapes`, its `(0, 0, 0)` on the block above the ground. `afloat` stands it on the water where the ground is under water; without it, nothing stands there. `place = "floor"` puts its `(0, 0, 0)` on the air block over a cave floor, `"ceiling"` on the air block under a ceiling (build it down from there).
ThingRule.typedef: { shapes: { Schematic }, chance: (Field | number)?, biome: string?, when: (Field | number)?, afloat: boolean?, place: ("top" | "floor" | "ceiling")?, y: { number }? }

Think.title: Think type
Think.lead: What `on_think` gets: `n` bodies, and one buffer for each column with one f64 per body (entry i at byte i * 8). A yes or no is 1 or 0, an id of nothing is 0. Write the last nine to change them; a value left as it was changes nothing.

TimeName.title: TimeName type
TimeName.lead: A named time of day that `world.time` holds the sky at: sunrise, day, noon, sunset, night or midnight.
TimeName.typedef: "sunrise" | "day" | "noon" | "sunset" | "night" | "midnight" x: number, y: number, z: number, magnitude: (self: Vec3) -> number, unit: (self: Vec3) -> Vec3, dot: (self: Vec3, other: Vec3) -> number, cross: (self: Vec3, other: Vec3) -> Vec3, distance: (self: Vec3, other: Vec3) -> number, lerp: (self: Vec3, other: Vec3, t: number) -> Vec3, floor: (self: Vec3) -> Vec3, with: (self: Vec3, fields: { x: number?, y: number?, z: number? }) -> Vec3,

Tween.title: Tween type
Tween.lead: A field easing over time, from tween or camera.path.

Ui.title: ui global · type Ui
Ui.lead: Titles, chat, the action bar, boss bars, the sidebar and the tab list: for everyone in a room (the `ui` global, or `room.ui`), or for one player (`player.ui`, the same calls). "Everyone" below is one player on `player.ui`.

members.name: title
members.signature: ui.title(opts: { title: Text ?, subtitle: Text ?, color: Ink ?, fade_in: number ?, stay: number ?, fade_out: number ?, })
members.description: Shows a title and subtitle to everyone in the room; fades and stay are in seconds.

members.name: actionbar
members.description: Shows a line above the hotbar to everyone in the room.

members.name: bossbar
members.signature: ui.bossbar(opts: { title: Text ?, color: BarColor ?, progress: number ? }?) → Bar
members.description: Shows a boss bar to everyone in the room and returns its handle; progress 0..1. 1.8 reads the title on its action bar.

members.name: sidebar
members.signature: ui.sidebar(opts: ({ title: Text ?, lines: { Text }? } | false)?)
members.description: Sets the sidebar for everyone in the room; lines run top to bottom and only changed lines are sent. nil or false removes the sidebar.

members.name: tab
members.description: Sets the player list's header and footer for everyone in the room.

members.name: box
members.signature: ui.box(opts: { id: string ?, width: number, height: number, color: Ink ?, radius: number ? }) → LayoutNode
members.description: The pieces of a layout (see "Layouts"). Sizes are pixels of the game's own HUD; a box is 1 to 256 a side. An item with an `id` is live.

members.name: image
members.signature: ui.image(opts: { id: string ?, image: Texture, color: Ink ? }) → LayoutNode

members.name: label
members.signature: ui.label(opts: { id: string ?, text: string ?, width: number ?, align: LayoutAlign ?, color: Ink ?, bold: boolean ? }) → LayoutNode
members.description: Words in the client's own letters, space to `~`. Give a label whose words change a `width`.

members.name: row
members.signature: ui.row(opts: { gap: number ?, align: LayoutAlign ?, [number]: LayoutNode }) → LayoutNode
members.description: The children are the list part: `ui.row{ gap = 4, a, b }`.

members.name: column
members.signature: ui.column(opts: { gap: number ?, align: LayoutAlign ?, [number]: LayoutNode }) → LayoutNode

members.name: define
members.signature: ui.define(name: string, opts: { anchor: ("bottom" | "top")?, margin: number ?, cursor: boolean ?, [number]: LayoutNode }) → Layout
members.description: A layout of one child, centred over the hotbar with its bottom edge `margin` pixels above the screen's (40, or 25 when `hide_hud` takes the hearts and the food away). While the pack loads only.

members.name: kit
members.description: What a dialog is made of (see "Dialogs"): row, column, stack, space, text, image, and window, button, tabs, close, badge, dot, progress, divider, card, grid, theme, mix and SCREEN.

Used.title: Used type
Used.lead: What `on_use` answers. Never true or false.

Vec3.title: Vec3 type
Vec3.typedef: typeof(setmetatable({} :: Vec3Fields, {} :: r: number, g: number, b: number, lerp: (self: Color, other: Color, t: number) -> Color,

Video.title: Video type
Video.lead: A raw RGB video playing on a picture, from `picture:play`; read `playing` or call `stop`.

members.name: stop
members.description: False once it ends (and does not loop) or is stopped. Stops the video.

View.title: View type
View.lead: One player's own layer over a screen or canvas, from `screen:view(player)`; only they see it, drawn with the same calls.

members.name: destroy

World.title: world global · type World
World.lead: A room's blocks, entities, displays, screens and time: the `world` global, or `room.world`.

members.name: on_generate
members.description: Called for a chunk each time it comes into memory, in a script world; it must make the same blocks every time.

members.name: on_populate
members.description: Each chunk the overworld terrain made, once, after it made it.

members.name: dimension
members.description: Another world of the server's group, by dimension id or its last part ("dungeon", "minecraft:the_nether"): that world's own `world` table.

members.name: drop
members.description: A stack on the ground at a block, as a broken block leaves one.

members.name: container
members.description: A chest's stacks, or nil where the block keeps none.

members.name: rules
members.signature: world.rules(opts: { survival: boolean ?, fall: boolean ?, damage: boolean ?, hunger: boolean ?, anticheat: boolean ?, day_cycle: boolean ?, redstone: boolean ? }?) → Rules
members.description: `world.rules{ fall = true }` switches one on, false off; a rule left out or nil keeps its value, and a number or a string is an error. `world.rules()` reads them.

members.name: raycast
members.signature: world.raycast(from: Vec3, direction: Vec3, max: number ?) → RayHit ?
members.description: The first block a ray from `from` along `direction` meets within `max` blocks, and the face it came in through; nil for none.

members.name: sees
members.description: True when no block stops the line from `from` to `to`: a block with a collision box does (glass, leaves), water and grass do not.

members.name: raycasts
members.signature: world.raycasts(rays: buffer, out: buffer, n: number)
members.description: `n` lines at once. `rays` holds six f64 a line (from x, y, z, to x, y, z); `out` gets one f64 a line: how far along it the first block is that stops it, or -1 for a clear line.

members.name: light_at

members.name: path

The game's own search: a step up of one block, falls of `fall` (3). `size` is { width, height } (0.6, 1.8); `swim` goes through water; `range` (the distance + 16) and `budget` (2000 nodes) stop a long search, which then gives the part that came closest.

members.signature: world.zone(opts: { from: Vec3, to: Vec3, on_enter: ((player: Player) -> ())?, on_leave: ((player: Player) -> ())? }) → Zone
members.description: Makes a box of blocks, both corners included, that knows who is in it; checked once a tick by feet position. Ends with the script.

members.name: set_block
