members.description: `skin` is for "player_head" and "player_wall_head" only: an account's name, or the raw `textures` property.

members.name: set_blocks
members.signature: world.set_blocks(changes: { { at: Vec3, block: BlockRef, skin: HeadSkin ? } })
members.description: Sets many blocks at once, live, stored and sent; the cheapest way. A row takes `skin` too, for a player head.

members.name: fill
members.signature: world.fill(from: Vec3, to: Vec3, block: BlockRef)
members.description: Fills a box of blocks between two corners, live, stored and sent to everyone.

members.name: schematic
members.description: A file inside the pack; a path that leaves it, or one that is not there, is an error naming the file.

members.name: build
members.signature: world.build(fn: (b: Builder) -> (), opts: { detail: number ? }?) → Schematic
members.description: The same value, written in code instead of read from a file. `{ detail = 2 }`: coordinates are half blocks, fitted to slabs and stairs.

members.name: paste
members.signature: world.paste(schem: Schematic, origin: Vec3, opts: { air: boolean ?, part: string ? }?)
members.description: Live, stored and sent; air is skipped unless `air` is true.

members.name: get_block
members.description: `nil` where that chunk is not in memory: a read never generates.

members.name: block
members.description: The block there as the handle a hook gets: reads are live, and what it does lands on the next tick. `state` and `data` are for this pack's own blocks. `nil` where that chunk is not in memory.

members.name: get_biome
members.description: Returns the biome name of the column at `pos`; `nil` where that chunk is not in memory.

members.name: generate
members.description: Declares this world: the engine makes each chunk from the rules, on every core, and no script runs for a chunk.

members.name: get_blocks
members.description: A box, in x, then z, then y order.

members.name: items
members.description: The stacks on the ground: `{ id, item, count, at }` rows.

members.name: spawn
members.signature: world.spawn(def: EntityDef | string, pos: Vec3, data: { [string]: any }?) → EntityHandle ?
members.description: Puts an entity at a point and returns its handle. A mob kind of the game by name (`world.spawn("cow", pos)`) is the game's own entity, and takes no `data`. A pack's own kind takes the data it starts life holding. `nil` for a kind nothing defined and this game does not have.

members.name: entities
members.signature: world.entities(query: { near: Vec3 ?, radius: number ?, kind: string ?, mob: boolean ? }?) → { EntityHandle }
members.description: Live and queued entities, in ascending id. Optional near/radius select a sphere; kind filters by canonical name. near and radius go together. `mob = true` gives the mobs only, `mob = false` the rest.

members.name: explode
members.description: A blast at a point. The power is clamped by this game's own column and the tick's explosion budget decides when it goes off, never whether.

members.name: on_block_break
members.signature: world.on_block_break(fn: (player: Player ?, pos: Vec3, block: string) -> ()) → Connection
members.description: What the survival tick did. Observe-only: the world has already changed, and what the callback returns is not read.

members.name: on_block_place
members.signature: world.on_block_place(fn: (player: Player ?, pos: Vec3, block: string) -> ()) → Connection
members.description: Tells after a block was placed, with its canonical name. Observe-only; `player` is nil when nobody placed it or they left.

members.name: on_entity_spawn
members.description: Tells after a mob appeared, with its handle and name; a natural spawn fires it on every game version that has one, and a pack's own `world.spawn("cow", pos)` fires it too. Mob kinds only.

members.name: on_entity_death
members.description: Tells after a mob died; it is gone, so its id and name is all there is. Mob kinds only.

members.name: time
members.signature: world.time((at: number | TimeName | (s: number) -> number | TimeName) -> ()) → & (() -> number)
members.description: Holds the sky at a time (ticks, or "sunrise", "day", "noon", "sunset", "night", "midnight"), or asks a function each tick, `s` seconds after the call. With no argument: the time of day now, 0 to 23999.

members.name: light
members.description: Sends players light no block makes, 1 to 15 a source; each call replaces the last, `{}` ends it. 1.14 and later.

members.name: screen
members.signature: world.screen(opts: { at: Vec3, facing: Facing | "up", up: Facing ?, width: number ?, height: number ?, glow: boolean ?, on_click: ((player: Player, x: number, y: number, button: "left" | "right") -> ())?, }) → Screen
members.description: Puts a wall of map frames, `width` by `height` frames (128 pixels each), in front of a wall; `at` is the top-left frame. Returns a Screen.

members.name: canvas
members.signature: world.canvas(opts: { width: number ?, height: number ? }?) → Canvas
members.description: Makes a picture of `width` by `height` maps (1 by 1 by default, 16 at most a side) with no frame of its own, for a frame, a hand or a screen.

members.name: display
members.signature: world.display((opts: { kind: "model", model: Model, at: Vec3 ?, rotation: Orientation ?, scale: (number | Vec3)?, -- models require equal positive axes paint: { [string]: Ink }?, fallback: string ?, seats: { Vec3 }?, lead: boolean ?, }) -> ModelDisplay) → & ((opts: { kind: "item" | "text" | "block" | "frame", at: Vec3 ?, rotation: Orientation ?, scale: (Vec3 | number)?, billboard: Billboard ?, glow: (Ink | false)?, item: ItemSpec ?, canvas: Canvas ?, context: Context ?, text: Text ?, color: Ink ?, background: (Ink | false)?, line_width: number ?, shadow: boolean ?, block: string ?, facing: ScreenFacing ?, invisible: boolean ?, glide: number ?, lead: boolean ?, }) -> Display)
members.description: A model stands in the world through the same call as everything else, and is the one kind that hands back something other than a Display.

members.name: hitbox
members.signature: world.hitbox(opts: { at: Vec3, width: number ?, height: number ?, depth: number ?, solid: boolean ?, on_click: ((player: Player, button: "left" | "right") -> ())?, }) → Hitbox
members.description: Makes an invisible box a player can click; `solid` also makes it a wall. `depth` is the width unless given. 1.19.4 and later.

members.name: npc
members.signature: world.npc(opts: { name: string ?, at: Vec3 ?, rotation: BodyRotation ?, skin: (string | { value: string, signature: string } | false)?, }) → Npc
members.description: Places a player-shaped entity every client from 1.8 sees; removed when the script ends or reloads.

members.name: puppet
members.signature: world.puppet(opts: { kind: string, at: Vec3 ?, rotation: BodyRotation ?, name: Text ? }) → Puppet
members.description: Places a mob's body with no mind of its own that the script moves; its name tag always shows. An error when this game has no such mob kind.

members.name: spawn_point
members.description: Where players arrive in this room; writable. The same value as the room's `spawn_point`.

Worn.title: Worn type
Worn.lead: Armour, head first; each piece is an item like any other.
Worn.typedef: { head: ItemSpec?, chest: ItemSpec?, legs: ItemSpec?, feet: ItemSpec? }

Zone.title: Zone type
Zone.lead: A box of blocks that knows who is in it, checked once a tick.

members.name: contains
members.description: Returns true when the player is in the zone.

members.name: players
members.description: Returns who is in the zone now.

members.name: destroy
members.description: Removes the zone.

citadel.title: citadel global
citadel.lead: The engine itself: the log, the engine and game versions, the environment, and this pack's tick budget.

members.name: log
members.description: Writes its arguments to the server log, under this pack's name.

members.name: budget
members.description: This pack's slice of a tick, and what it did with it.

members.name: on_slow
members.description: Called when a batch runs out of budget; at most once a second.

members.name: version
members.description: The engine version, e.g. "0.1.0".

members.name: game
members.description: The game version from citadel.yml, e.g. "1.8.9".

members.name: env
members.description: "development", "unlisted" or "published": which copy of the game this is.

color.title: color global
color.lead: Makes a Color from red, green and blue, 0 to 1; also from hue, saturation and value, or the nearest map colour.
color.typedef: ((r: number, g: number, b: number) -> Color)

members.name: hsv
members.signature: color.hsv(h: number, s: number, v: number) → Color
members.description: Makes a colour from hue, saturation and value, each 0 to 1.

members.name: nearest
members.description: The colour a picture really shows, since it snaps to the map palette.

members.name: gradient
members.signature: color.gradient(list: { Ink }, u: number, loop: boolean ?) → Color
members.description: The colour `u` (0 to 1) of the way along the list; with `loop`, `u` wraps and the last colour runs back into the first.

colors.title: colors global
colors.lead: Every `ColorName` as a value; any other name is an error naming the nearest ("grey" says "gray").

commands.title: commands global · type Commands
commands.lead: Adds a room's slash commands from a usage line: the `commands` global, or `room.commands`.

members.name: add
members.signature: commands.add(usage: string, fn: (player: Player, args: { [string]: any }) -> string ?, opts: CommandOpts ?) → Command
members.description: usage: "bet <amount:integer 1..10000> [color:red|black]". Types: word, integer, number (with an optional min..max), player, a|b|c, text... (the rest of the line as a string), words... (as a list). args holds each argument by name; an optional one not typed is nil. Return a string and the player reads it in red.

members.name: run
members.description: Runs a pack's command for player as if they typed it ("/servers"), with their permissions. false when no pack in their room declared it.

data.title: data global
data.lead: Helpers for persistent data views. Player.data remains an ordinary Lua table.

members.name: copy
members.description: A detached JSON snapshot as ordinary Lua values/tables.

members.name: insert
members.signature: data.insert((list: DataView, value: any) -> ()) → & ((list: DataView, index: number, value: any) -> ())
members.description: Insert into a nested data list; omitted index appends.

members.name: remove
members.description: Remove and return a detached value; omitted index removes the last element.

fields.title: fields global
fields.lead: Recipes for numbers over the world, for `world.generate`.

members.name: noise
members.signature: fields.noise(opts: { seed: number ?, scale: number ?, octaves: number ?, gain: number ?, lacunarity: number ?, solid: boolean ? }?) → Field
members.description: Smooth noise, about -1..1. `solid = true` changes with y too.

members.name: mix
members.signature: fields.mix(a: Field | number, b: Field | number, t: Field | number) → Field
members.description: `a` where `t` is 0, `b` where it is 1.

members.name: hash
members.description: One number 0..1 for each square of `cell` blocks (1).

members.name: cells
members.signature: fields.cells(size: number, seed: number ?) → { distance: Field, random: Field }
members.description: A scattered grid, one point per `size` blocks: the distance to the nearest point, and that point's own number 0..1.

members.name: height
members.description: The y of the surface of a column, as a block.

members.name: slope
members.description: The step to the steepest of the four columns beside this one.

members.name: water
members.description: How deep the water is over the surface; 0 and below on land.

members.name: shore
members.description: 1 on a column at the water's edge with water beside it.

members.name: depth
members.description: Blocks under the surface: `fields.height - fields.y`.

members.name: room
members.description: The height of the open space a block is in: 0 in rock, 64 at most (and in the open sky). `density` cannot use it.

fx.title: fx global · type Fx
fx.lead: Particles for a room: Minecraft's particle packet; the `fx` global, or `room.fx`.

members.name: particle
members.signature: fx.particle(name: string, pos: Vec3 | { Vec3 }, opts: { count: number ?, spread: (number | Vec3)?, velocity: Vec3 ?, speed: number ?, color: Ink ?, size: number ?, }?)
members.description: Shows particle `name` ("dust", "end_rod", "explosion", "firework", "flame", "note", "totem_of_undying") at `pos`, or at every point of a list. Each point reaches players in the room within 64 blocks of its origin in 3D, including the boundary, before spread or velocity. `count` (1) at each point in a box `spread` (0) out; or with `velocity`, one particle moving along it (`speed` 1 then, else 0). `color` and `size` are for dust only.

game.title: game global · type Game
game.lead: The game version a room runs, its entity kinds, blocks and items, and the pack's own blocks, items and recipes: the `game` global, or `room.game`.

members.name: block
members.description: Returns one block in this version's numbers, or nil for a name this game has no word for.

members.name: item
members.description: Returns an item this game has, or nil for a name it does not; never an error.

members.name: texture
members.signature: game.texture((width: number, height: number) -> Texture) → & ((file: string) -> Texture)
members.description: Returns a new texture of width by height pixels, see-through until drawn on, for a pack's block or item. A texture to draw on (512 at most a side), or a PNG file in the pack (4096 at most a side).

members.name: version
members.description: This game's version, such as "a0.1.0".

members.name: world_height
members.description: How tall the world is in blocks: 128, or 256 for a 1.8.9 world.

members.name: sea_level
members.description: The y of this world's sea level.

members.name: entities
members.description: The kinds of entity: `define` a pack's own, `amend` the game's own, and read a kind of the game: a mob kind by either spelling (`game.entities.cow`, `game.entities.Cow`), a kind that is not a mob by its name (`game.entities.arrow`); nil where the game has none. It iterates every kind, including pack definitions: `for name, kind in game.entities do`.

members.name: blocks
members.description: The one table that *adds* to a version rather than reading it.

members.name: biomes
members.description: Biomes of the pack's own: a vanilla biome with other colours and weather.

members.name: recipes
members.description: What a crafting grid and a furnace make of a pack's items; recipes are added while the pack loads.

members.name: items
members.description: Defines items of the pack's own, with a texture for clients from 1.21.4.

members.name: terrain
members.description: What this world's overworld is made of: `snow` and `steps`, as citadel.yml writes them; read-only, nil when there is no list.

http.title: http global
http.lead: Fetches public URLs. The call waits like `task.wait`.

members.name: get
members.signature: http.get(url: string, options: {query: {[string]: string}?, headers: {[string]: string}?, timeout: number ?, cache: number ?}?) → HttpResponse
members.description: GET a URL. `cache` is the seconds a 200 answer is kept on disk; `timeout` is 1 to 60 seconds, 15 by default.

members.name: socket
members.signature: http.socket(url: string, options: {headers: {[string]: string}?, on_message: (message: SocketMessage) -> ()}) → Socket
members.description: Opens a WebSocket (`ws` or `wss`) and keeps it open: when the connection ends, the engine dials again. `on_message` gets each message on a tick.

hub.title: hub global
hub.lead: What Minefort tells its own hub: never the servers or the hubs, which it browses with network.browse. Empty lists on every other server. The first call of experiences waits up to two seconds for Minefort's list.

members.name: experiences
members.signature: hub.experiences() → { {slot: number, experience: string, title: string, pitch: string ?, icon: string ?, banner: string ?, players: number ?} }
members.description: The portals of the experience grounds. `experience` is what `/play` takes.

members.name: rent
members.signature: hub.rent(player: Player | string, slot: number, product: string, experience: string ?) → string ?
members.description: Offers portal `slot` for Gems, to lead to `experience` (what `/play` takes). Returns the request id, or nil. More time on your own portal may leave `experience` out.

members.name: point
members.signature: hub.point(player: Player | string, slot: number, experience: string) → boolean
members.description: Turns the player's own live portal to another published experience.

message.title: message global
message.lead: Sends a chat line to everyone in the main room; `color` is for the words that did not pick one.

models.title: models global
models.lead: The models this pack makes. They go into the resource pack a client is handed when it joins, so `new` belongs at the top of the script: calling it from a callback is an error.

members.name: new
members.description: Makes a model named `name` from the parts `fn` builds and returns it. Call it at the top of the script; from a callback it is an error.

network.title: network global
network.lead: An experience made of more than one server: asks for instances of its members and is told about them. A failed call answers nil and a reason. Calls yield, but for `status`. Without a network every answer is no.

members.name: start
members.signature: network.start(options: {member: string, label: string, slots: number, data: any}) → (NetworkStarted ?, string ?)
members.description: Starts an instance of `member`. Answers at once; it is online later.

members.name: find
members.signature: network.find(options: {label: string, players: number ?, party: (Player | string)?, start: {member: string, slots: number, data: any}?}) → (NetworkStarted ?, string ?)
members.description: The instance to send `players` players to (1 unless set), or nil when none has room. With `start`, one is started when none has room.

members.name: stop
members.description: Stops an instance of this network.

members.name: info
members.signature: network.info() → ({network: string, id: string ?, member: string ?, label: string ?, slots: number ?, data: any}?, string ?)
members.description: This server's network, by name, and the instance this pack runs on: `id` and the fields after it are nil on a server that is not one.

members.name: status
members.signature: network.status(options: {open: number, status: string ?, meta: any})
members.description: Says where this instance is. At most one a second is sent: the first at once, then the last of those that came after.

members.name: on_instance_start
members.description: Called when an instance is first seen: started, or already running.

members.name: on_instance_change
members.description: Called when an instance's state, open, status or meta changes.

members.name: on_instance_stop
members.description: Called with the id of an instance that is gone.

members.name: online
members.description: How many play on this network (everyone on Minefort on the platform's hub), or in one mode's games. An answer is kept for 5 seconds.

members.name: browse
members.signature: network.browse(view: "search" | "for-you" | "recent" | "featured", options: {player: (Player | string)?, query: string ?, page: number ?, category: string ?, online: boolean ?, ids: {string}?, sort: ("players" | "name")?, also: {recent: boolean ?, favorites: {string}?}?}?) → ({BrowseEntry}?, (number | string)?, {recent: {rows: {BrowseEntry}, total: number} | false | nil, favorites: {rows: {BrowseEntry}, total: number} | false | nil}?)
members.description: The platform's hub finding every network, in the order to show them. nil and why on a refusal, and anywhere but that hub. One page of 6 rows (page from 1), and how many there are in all; nil and why on a refusal.

members.name: instances
members.description: Everything this network runs: this experience's own always-on servers (on the platform's hub, the hubs), then its games started on demand. With `label`, only that mode's games.

noise.title: noise global
noise.lead: Smooth random numbers for a generator, made by the engine.

members.name: new
members.signature: noise.new(opts: { seed: number ?, scale: number ?, octaves: number ?, gain: number ?, lacunarity: number ? }?) → Noise
members.description: Returns a noise. `scale` is the size of a hill in blocks (64), and each of the `octaves` (1) adds detail `lacunarity` (2) times finer and `gain` (0.5) times as strong.

parts.title: parts global
parts.lead: Declares named parts of a stored world and the generators that build them; nothing runs on load.

members.name: define
members.description: Declares a named part and its generator; nothing runs on load. A generator runs on request, or when its code changes.

players.title: players global · type Players
players.lead: A room's players and their events: the `players` global, or `room.players`.

members.name: on_join
members.description: Calls `fn` when a player arrives: on the globals when a client connects, on a room's table each time a player moves into it.

members.name: on_leave
members.description: The same player value on_join had; it can no longer be sent to.

members.name: list
members.description: Returns every player in the room.

members.name: get
members.description: Returns the player with this name, or nil.

members.name: count
members.description: Returns how many players are in the room.

members.name: near
members.description: Who is within a radius of a point, and who is inside a box of blocks.

members.name: within
members.description: Returns every player inside a box of blocks, corners included.

members.name: on_click
members.description: Calls `fn` on a left or right click; `hit` holds the button and the entity, player, block and face it met.

members.name: on_sneak
members.description: Calls `fn` once per sneak press and release; `down` is true on the press.

members.name: on_slot
members.description: Calls `fn` when a player picks a hotbar slot, 1..9.

members.name: on_chat
members.signature: players.on_chat(fn: (player: Player, text: string) -> boolean ?) → Connection
members.description: Return false and the line is not said.

members.name: on_pickup
members.signature: players.on_pickup(fn: (player: Player ?, item: string, count: number) -> ()) → Connection
members.description: A stack taken off the ground, and one that landed on it. `player` is nil where the world dropped it, or where they have already left.

members.name: on_drop
members.signature: players.on_drop(fn: (player: Player ?, item: string, count: number) -> ()) → Connection
members.description: Calls `fn` when a stack lands on the ground; `player` is nil where the world dropped it or they have left.

members.name: on_death
members.signature: players.on_death(fn: (player: Player ?, cause: string, message: string, by: Player ?) -> ()) → Connection
members.description: Calls `fn` when a player dies, with the cause (fall, drown, void, lava, ...) and the line broadcast; `player` is nil once they have left.

members.name: on_respawn
members.description: Calls `fn` when a player respawns; `player` is nil once they have left.

members.name: on_break
members.signature: players.on_break(fn: (player: Player ?, pos: Vec3, block: string) -> boolean ?) → Connection
members.description: Cancellable. Return `false` to stop it; return nothing to let it through. These are asked *before* the world changes and the engine waits milliseconds for the answer, so they must be quick and must never `task.wait`.  Timeout, error, overflow and disabled handlers deny the action. Across packs any `false` wins. See docs/luau-api.md, "saying no".

members.name: on_place
members.signature: players.on_place(fn: (player: Player ?, pos: Vec3, block: string) -> boolean ?) → Connection
members.description: Asks `fn` before a player puts a block down; return false to cancel it. A missed deadline denies the place.

members.name: on_damage
members.signature: players.on_damage(fn: (player: Player ?, hit: DamageHit) -> boolean ?) → Connection
members.description: Asks `fn` before damage lands on a player; return false to refuse it. A missed deadline denies it. A pack's own `player:damage` is not asked about.

rooms.title: rooms global
rooms.lead: The main room and new isolated rooms with their own chunks, players and effects.

members.name: create
members.signature: rooms.create(opts: { spawn_point: Vec3 ?, generate: ((chunk: Chunk) -> ())? }) → Room
members.description: Creates an isolated room with its own chunks, players and effects; `spawn_point` defaults to (0.5, 65, 0.5), `generate` fills each chunk.

members.name: main
members.description: The main room, whose tables are the globals `world`, `players`, `ui` and the rest.

routes.title: routes global
routes.lead: How players get between the worlds of the group.

members.name: add
members.signature: routes.add(route: { from: string, to: string, trigger: { block: string, ticks: number ? }?, placement: Vec3 ? })
members.description: From one dimension to another: standing `ticks` ticks in `block`, or only by `player:travel` without a trigger; arriving at `placement` or the destination's spawn.

shop.title: shop global
shop.lead: Sells this experience's products for Gems. Minefort asks the player in its own dialog; the pack learns only paid or not, never a balance, price or reason. Calls yield. Without the platform's shop every answer is no.

members.name: prompt
members.signature: shop.prompt(player: Player | string, product: string) → string ?
members.description: Asks Minefort to offer `product` to the player. Returns the request id, or nil when it was not offered.

members.name: owns
members.signature: shop.owns(player: Player | string, product: string) → boolean
members.description: Whether the player owns this pass.

members.name: on_paid
members.description: Called once per paid purchase; returning without an error hands it over. An error leaves it waiting, to be called again later.

members.name: on_declined
members.description: Called when the player said no or did not answer.

sound.title: sound global · type Sound
sound.lead: Plays and stops sounds for everyone in a room: the `sound` global, or `room.sound`.

members.name: play
members.signature: sound.play(name: string, opts: { at: Vec3 ?, volume: number ?, pitch: number ?, category: string ?, }?)
members.description: Plays a sound by name to everyone in the room; volume above 1 carries further, pitch 0.5..2.0.

members.name: stop
members.description: One sound by name, or every sound, for everyone in the room; 1.13+.

members.name: stream
members.signature: sound.stream(opts: { url: string ?, file: string ?, at: (SoundSpeaker | { SoundSpeaker })?, to: (Player | { Player })?, distance: number ?, loop: boolean ?, name: string ?, }) → SoundStream
members.description: A live stream (MP3, or an FLV's sound) or a pack's sound file (OGG, MP3, WAV), heard through the mod a screen's stream uses. With `at`, from speakers: each player hears every speaker within `distance`. Without, from no place, at one volume. `to`: only these players. `loop`: files only.

storage.title: storage global
storage.lead: Values a pack keeps between restarts, saved by key in its storage.json.

members.name: status
members.description: Last persistence error and whether there are unsaved changes.

members.name: flush
members.description: Yields until saved; raises an error on failure. After initialization only.

members.name: get
members.description: Returns the value saved under `key`, or nil when there is none.

members.name: set
members.description: Saves a value under `key` in this pack's storage.json; nil forgets it.

members.name: keys
members.description: Every key, sorted; with a prefix, only those that start with it.

stores.title: stores global
stores.lead: Shared durable storage: the experience's one store, leases and raw queries; calls yield.

members.name: open
members.description: Returns the experience's one store. It takes no id; passing one is an error.

members.name: request
members.signature: stores.request(query: {[string]: any}, bytes: string ?) → ({[string]: any}, string ?)
members.description: Sends one raw query to the store and yields until it answers; returns the answer table and any blob bytes.

members.name: lease
members.signature: stores.lease(key: string, holder: string, ttl_ms: number) → number
members.description: Takes a lease on `key` for `holder`, lasting `ttl_ms` milliseconds (up to one hour); returns a fencing token.

members.name: renew
members.description: Extends the lease on `key` that `token` holds.

members.name: release
members.description: Gives up the lease on `key` that `token` holds.

members.name: blob_list
members.signature: stores.blob_list(owner: string) → {{store: string, key: string, version: number, size: number}}
members.description: Lists a player's blobs across all blob stores in this scope, each with its store, key, version and size.

task.title: task global
task.lead: Tasks return threads; cancel with task.cancel(thread).

time.title: time global
time.lead: Clocks for a pack: a callback every tick, one every few seconds, and the seconds since the pack started.

members.name: on_tick
members.description: Calls `fn` every tick, 20 times a second, with the tick number; keep it short.

members.name: every
members.description: Calls `fn` every `seconds`, precise to 1 ms and never drifting; use it for music.

members.name: now
members.description: Seconds since the pack started.

tween.title: tween global
tween.lead: Any live field eased over time: numbers, vec3 and color values tween; a table field is replaced when it lands.

members.name: on_populate

members.name: dimension

members.name: drop

members.name: container

members.description: `n` lines at once. `rays` holds six f64 a line (from x, y, z, to x, y, z); `out` gets one f64 a line: how far along it the first block is that stops it, or -1 for a clear line.

The game's own search: a step up of one block, falls of `fall` (3). `size` is { width, height } (0.6, 1.8); `swim` goes through water; `range` (the distance + 16) and `budget` (2000 nodes) stop a long search, which then gives the part that came closest.

members.name: schematic

members.name: generate
members.description: Declares this world: the engine makes each chunk from the rules, on every core, and no script runs for a chunk.

members.name: get_blocks

members.name: items
members.description: The stacks on the ground: `{ id, item, count, at }` rows.

members.description: Puts an entity at a point and returns its handle. A mob kind of the game by name (`world.spawn("cow", pos)`) is the game's own entity, and takes no `data`. A pack's own kind takes the data it starts life holding. `nil` for a kind nothing defined and this game does not have.

members.name: explode

members.name: on_block_break

members.description: What the survival tick did. Observe-only: the world has already changed, and what the callback returns is not read.

members.name: on_entity_death
members.description: Tells after a mob died; it is gone, so its id and name is all there is. Mob kinds only.

members.description: Holds the sky at a time (ticks, or "sunrise", "day", "noon", "sunset", "night", "midnight"), or asks a function each tick, `s` seconds after the call. With no argument: the time of day now, 0 to 23999.

members.name: light
members.description: Sends players light no block makes, 1 to 15 a source; each call replaces the last, `{}` ends it. 1.14 and later.

members.description: Puts a wall of map frames, `width` by `height` frames (128 pixels each), in front of a wall; `at` is the top-left frame. Returns a Screen.

members.description: Makes a picture of `width` by `height` maps (1 by 1 by default, 16 at most a side) with no frame of its own, for a frame, a hand or a screen.

data.lead: What this block remembers beyond its state; kept with the position, saved with the chunk, and gone when the block goes. Nested writes are tracked; whole-record assignment is supported. Copy before keeping it beyond the hook.

schedule.lead: Asks for this block's `on_tick`, `tick_every` seconds from now.

set.lead: Puts another block at this position.

state.title: blockAt.state
state.lead: Which of this definition's states it is in, counting from 1. Writable, and bounds-checked against the definition's own `looks` list: it *is* the block state, so a crop's stages cost nothing.

item.title: blockDef.item

facing.lead: Turns its front to whoever places it; `block.facing` reads and turns it.

hardness.title: blockSpec.hardness
hardness.lead: Seconds-scale, as vanilla's hardness is; below zero is unbreakable.

item.title: blockSpec.item
item.lead: The block in a hand. Its `id` is set to the block's name, so placing it puts this block down, and a break leaves it unless `drops` says. false is no item, also for a block with a texture.

label.title: blockSpec.label

looks.title: blockSpec.looks

alive.lead: Whether it is still in the world. A hook only runs for one that is.

data.lead: A pack-defined entity's attached record. Nested edits write through. Saved with persist = "save". Built-in entities raise an error on access. on_steer/on_tick views expire after the callback batch; copy to keep a snapshot.

driver.title: entityHandle.driver
driver.lead: Whether it is in water now. False for an entity that is not alive. The player supplying driving input from seat 1; nil for an NPC or empty seat.

flying.title: entityHandle.flying
flying.lead: Intent, a living body with can_fly only: true flies (no gravity; forward moves it along its look, pitch included), false falls and walks. Setting it true on another body is an error.

forward.title: entityHandle.forward
forward.lead: The intent fields: what a body *wants* to do, which is what steering is. Writing one outside `on_steer` lasts until the next decision.

health.title: entityHandle.health
health.lead: Its health now. Nil once it is gone.

hostile.title: entityHandle.hostile
hostile.lead: Whether its kind is hostile. Nil once it is gone.

id.title: entityHandle.id
id.lead: Its entity id, the one players.on_click reports in `hit.entity_id`.

jumping.title: entityHandle.jumping
jumping.lead: Intent: whether it wants to jump. A vehicle's seat 1 writes it from the keys every tick.

max_health.title: entityHandle.max_health
max_health.lead: The most health its kind gives it. Nil for an entity that is not a mob and once it is gone. Read-only.

move.title: entityHandle:move
move.lead: Gone on the next tick. Sets position and optional rotation together.

name.title: entityHandle.name
name.lead: The kind's name: "cow", "rave:rocket". Nil once it is gone.

nearby.title: entityHandle:nearby
nearby.lead: What else is around it, by horizontal distance.

on_ground.title: entityHandle.on_ground
on_ground.lead: Whether it stands on something. Nil once it is gone.

origin.title: entityHandle.origin
origin.lead: The block it used to be, for anything that arrived through a transition; nil for anything that was never a block.

paint.title: entityHandle.paint
paint.lead: Every occupant by seat number, including NPCs; nil means empty. Material name to colour; write-only.

physics.title: entityHandle.physics
physics.lead: Which order of operations moves it: "vehicle", "living", "falling", "item" or "none".

play.title: entityHandle:play
play.lead: Model size: reads vec3; write a positive number or equal-axis vec3. Nil without a model. Plays a model entity's animation from the start; on the one already playing, `speed` only changes its speed.

push.title: entityHandle:push
push.lead: A shove, in blocks a tick, added to what it is already doing.

settle.title: entityHandle:settle
settle.lead: It stops being an entity and is a block again where it stands. No argument: the entity remembers what it was.

stop.title: entityHandle:stop
stop.lead: Stops a model entity's animation; the parts stay where they are.

strafe.title: entityHandle.strafe
strafe.lead: Intent: 1 left, -1 right. A vehicle's seat 1 writes it from the keys every tick.

velocity.title: entityHandle.velocity
velocity.lead: Where it is, live; writing it is a teleport. Nil once it is gone. Partial writes preserve other angles; nil after removal. Bodies have no roll. How it is moving, live; writing it is steering by hand. Nil once it is gone. writing it is steering by hand

attacks.title: entityKind.attacks
attacks.lead: Whether its hits hurt players. `nil`: on for a kind with `spawn = true`, else the room's `damage` rule. The kind's own setting is stronger than the room's rule. It covers the kind's own hit, its arrow (also after the shooter died) and a creeper's blast. `false` stops the damage to players only: a blast still breaks blocks.

behaviour.title: entityKind.behaviour
behaviour.lead: The name of the behaviour the engine runs for this kind, such as "sheep" or "living".

drop.title: entityKind.drop
drop.lead: The item its death leaves behind, such as "leather"; nil for none.

height.title: entityKind.height
height.lead: Its height in blocks, in this version's numbers.

interact.title: entityKind.interact
interact.lead: Whether a player's right click on it has the game's effect (milk, a saddle). `nil`: on for a kind with `spawn = true`, else the room's `survival`. `true` is an error on 1.8.9, which has no right click on a mob.

max_health.title: entityKind.max_health
max_health.lead: The most health one of this kind has, in this version's numbers. `health` on a kind is an error: health is what one entity has now.

mob.title: entityKind.mob
mob.lead: Whether the kind is a mob: true for a cow, false for an arrow.

physics.title: entityKind.physics
physics.lead: For a kind that is not a mob, which order of operations moves it: "item", "falling", "vehicle" or "none". Nil for a mob kind.

profile.title: entityKind.profile
profile.lead: Read-only copy; nil for a specialized behavior without a shared profile.

registry_name.title: entityKind.registry_name
registry_name.lead: This version's own registry spelling: "Cow". A dungeon spawner stores this one.

spawn.title: entityKind.spawn
spawn.lead: The one writable field. `true`: the kind is in this world as the game defines it: it spawns by the game's own rule, also on a `mode: lite` world, and `attacks` and `interact` are on for it unless a pack sets them; an error on a 1.8.9 world with no biomes, where nothing would spawn it. `false`: the kind never spawns by itself in this world; spawner blocks, `world.spawn`, `/summon` and breeding still make it. `nil`: the pack says nothing and the world's default applies: no natural spawning on a `mode: lite` world and in a room from `rooms.create`, the game's own rule on a `mode: full` world and after `world.rules{ survival = true }`. A table is an error today. Reads what this pack set (`true`, `false` or nil), not the game's own rule. The value is this room's (`room.game.entities.cow.spawn`) and this pack's: a `false` of any pack wins. Every write is an error on a game with no natural spawning (a0.1.0 to a0.1.3).

speed.title: entityKind.speed
speed.lead: Blocks a tick at a full walk.

width.title: entityKind.width
width.lead: Its width in blocks, in this version's numbers.

accel.title: entitySpec.accel
accel.lead: physics = "vehicle" only: seconds from standing to top speed; 1 by default.

can_fly.title: entitySpec.can_fly
can_fly.lead: physics = "living" only: it may fly when its pack sets e.flying = true, and it takes no fall damage.

drops.title: entitySpec.drops
drops.lead: physics = "living" only: what it leaves when it dies. Each row is { item = "stick", count = 2 }, count = { least, most } for a random count, chance = 0.05 for a row that comes from one death in twenty, or a pack item. false or nil: nothing.

fallback.title: entitySpec.fallback
fallback.lead: What a client older than 1.21.4 sees in place of the model, such as "minecart".

looks.title: entitySpec.looks
looks.lead: A shape the client draws, or a model from models.new.

max_health.title: entitySpec.max_health
max_health.lead: physics = "living" only: the most health it has, and what it starts with. 1 to 1024; 20 by default.

name.title: entitySpec.name
name.lead: Your own word for the kind, lower case, digits and underscores; the pack's namespace is added for you ("rocket" is "rave:rocket").

on_damage.title: entitySpec.on_damage
on_damage.lead: Asked when a player hits it: answer "take" or "ignore". Nil or a missed deadline is "take". `by` is the player who hit.
on_damage.signature: entitySpec.on_damage((e: EntityHandle, amount: number, by: Player ?) -> ("take" | "ignore")?) → ?

on_load.title: entitySpec.on_load
on_load.lead: Told when one that already existed comes back: a saved chunk loaded it or a reload rebound it.

on_remove.title: entitySpec.on_remove
on_remove.lead: Told when it goes; `why` is "removed", "settled", "killed" or "unloaded". Not called when the pack goes away.

on_spawn.title: entitySpec.on_spawn
on_spawn.lead: Told when one of this kind is spawned; nothing waits on it and its answer is not read.

on_steer.title: entitySpec.on_steer
on_steer.lead: Runs before the physics each tick to decide where it goes; call `base(e)` to extend, leave it out to replace.

on_think.title: entitySpec.on_think
on_think.lead: define only. The brain: one call for all due bodies of the kind, with their numbers in columns. The engine never waits for it; the answer lands on the next tick it is there, and is never dropped.

on_tick.title: entitySpec.on_tick
on_tick.lead: Runs after the physics each tick to react to where it ended up; call `base(e)` to extend.

persist.title: entitySpec.persist
persist.lead: "save" brings it back with its chunk, `data` and all; "despawn", the default, is gone when the chunk goes.

physics.title: entitySpec.physics
physics.lead: Which order of operations moves it: "living", "falling", "item", "none", or "vehicle" to drive by seat 1's keys.

seats.title: entitySpec.seats

on_paid.title: shop.on_paid
on_paid.lead: Called once per paid purchase; returning without an error hands it over. An error leaves it waiting, to be called again later.

- `shop.on_paid(fn)` calls `fn({request, player, product})` for each undelivered paid purchase. It runs on the server the player is on: an experience has many servers, and each one hands over only to its own players. A purchase for a player who is not online waits until they join one. At least one active paid handler must complete successfully, and all active paid handlers must succeed, before the purchase is acknowledged. With no paid handler, or if one raises an error, it stays pending. An `on_declined` listener alone never acknowledges a paid purchase. Delivery can repeat after a failure or restart; use `purchase.request` as a durable idempotency key when granting a reward.
